fusions.name: Sand Kick
fusions.desc: Kicks up hot sand around you, dealing 4 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles. Each hit has a 25% chance of [Hindered] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Venomed Bite
fusions.desc: A venomous bite that deals 12 damage, leaves the target 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Poisoned] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Dropped Tail
fusions.desc: Drops a stone tail that fights for 14 seconds, striking an enemy within 3 tiles for 5 damage every 1.6 seconds.

fusions.name: Daylight Hardening
fusions.desc: In daylight, your armour rises by 12%.
